actual_scope: Sharp expected accumulated local rounding drift for two adaptive adjacent-grid calls sharing one uniform seed, for every positive integer denominator.
scope_change_reason: Original precision/tape boundary theorem instead of a supplier audit. Existing candidate open questions inspected during orientation were already settled; the new step quantifies, rather than rechecks, the PR6066 correlation warning.
bottleneck_link: Precision/tape side result: a restored seed reused across forward calls cannot be priced as fresh without a caller-specific conditional-error proof. No complete paid-profile or kappa gain is claimed.
stop_rule: Stop at the first proved exact two-call optimum and its matching witness; list longer reuse windows as open questions.
